{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers
converted_customers = sales[sales['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data)
valid_converted = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age_converted = valid_converted['customer_age'].mean()

# Also compute the count of valid converted customers
n_valid_converted = len(valid_converted)

# Print both results
print(f"Mean age: {mean_age_converted}")
print(f"Number of converted customers with valid age: {n_valid_converted}")"}
